newsitem.title: UK: UBS adds AXA, Holderbank, PT, Valeo to focus.
newsitem.headline: UBS adds AXA, Holderbank, PT, Valeo to focus.

text.p: UBS said on Tuesday it had added AXA, Holderbank, Portugal Telecom and Valeo to its European focus list.
It said in its latest European strategy quarterly the stocks would replace Blue Circle, Copenhagen Airport, Hoechst, Italgas and SBC.
It said it was recommending an overweight position in the Autos, Building & Construction and Telecoms sectors, and was therefore adding Valeo, Holderbank and Portugal Telecom.
UBS said it saw good upside potential in AXA, with a target price of 420 francs.
"Most markets look expensive and our return expectations are low," European strategy head Mark Howdle said.

The list contains up to 30 stocks drawn from analysts' key buy recommendations across European markets. The stocks are expected to provide significant outperformance of their local market over a 12 month horizon.
